title: Cultural Incongruencies in Artificial Intelligence
benchmark_measurement: The paper discusses how AI models can cause 'cultural erasure' by creating simplified caricatures of religious concepts, for instance, a text-to-image model rendering a mosque to symbolize all of Islam. It also notes the violation of cultural/religious values when models mix sacred words with profane ones.
findings: The paper posits that AI systems can cause 'cultural erasure' by oversimplifying complex religious concepts. An example given is a text-to-image model reducing 'Islam' to a 'mosque,' thereby ignoring the religion's broader political, historical, and artistic contexts. Additionally, it highlights that generative models can violate religious norms by producing text that mixes sacred and profane words, which is offensive in certain cultures.
